copy.curiosityHook: When your lethal talents make you a target and the mob closes in, how do you pull off an all-or-nothing gamble to walk away clean?
copy.description: In Las Vegas, a skilled bodyguard battling a severe gambling habit runs afoul of the local mob, forcing him to risk everything on one desperate final move to settle the score.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast, exciting, and tense; a compact 92-minute neon crime thriller built for an engaging watch solo or with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Simon West delivers a lean, 92-minute action thriller that channels classic Vegas grit with fast pacing, sharp suspense, and relentless mob-fueled friction.

allowedMaterial: Protagonist's lethal skills and gambling problem
Trouble with the mob and high-stakes final play
